result.instructions: Tools for FeedB, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What feedback came in this week, newest first?"; "Show me the last 20 feedback items with their ratings."; "Which recent feedback is negative, and what does it say?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes FeedB data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run feedb_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run feedb_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run feedb_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. feedb_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: feedb_list_feedback
tools.title: List feedback
tools.description: List the feedback your FeedB account has collected, newest first: rating, category, content, type, sentiment and created_at. Returns next_cursor; pass it as cursor to read the next page (null means the end). FeedB API: GET /api/v1/feedback.

cursor.description: Pass the next_cursor value from the previous page to get the next page. Omit for the first page.
